title: TAI owner deployment canonical image trigger
objective: Ensure every change to the owner-only exact-main REG.RU deployment authority automatically publishes canonical API, web, TAI and migration images for the same merged main SHA before preflight, activation and deployment are attempted.
boundaries: No production mutation is performed from the pull request
The trigger only publishes exact-SHA canonical images after merge to main
The owner preflight, activation and deployment commands remain separately authorized and fail-closed
No tenant, role, model, financial or write authority is widened
No public model listener is added
